## Who I am and what the group does

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}
- Real-time outbreak analysis. $R_t$, the number of new infections per
  infected person, estimated as an outbreak happens
- Delays and nowcasting. Nowcasting is estimating what has already
  happened but has not yet been reported
- Evaluation. Scoring forecasts so that teams can be compared
- Tools. `EpiNow2`, `epinowcast`, `scoringutils`, `primarycensored`,
  `epidist`, and the `EpiAware` Julia ecosystem
:::
